title: Deaths caused by snakebites a ‘notifiable disease’ says Maharashtra Health Minister Prakash Abitkar
summary: In the wake of the snakebite incident at a tribal residential ashram school in Japtalai village, Dhanora taluka, Gadchiroli, where six schoolgirls were bitten, with three losing their lives, the Public Health Department initiated steps to notify the disease.

title: BJP chief Nabin calls Congress the ‘New Muslim League’ over party’s Vande Mataram stance
summary: ‘The Congress has now formalised its insult (to Vande Mataram) into a resolution,’ the BJP president said

title: ED claims to have seized handwritten notes of Veena relating to fund transfer to Dubai
summary: The notes contain the “names of persons, amounts handled, spent” besides the amount transferred to Dubai. The searches conducted on the premises related to Veena and the promoters of CMRL on May 27, 2026, yielded the documents, it says

title: Ladakh civil society groups submit list of non-negotiable points to MHA officials, Chief Secretary in Leh
summary: The LAB and KDA are observing September as ‘Martyrs’ Month’ and plan to pay tribute to those who died during the agitation over Statehood and Sixth Schedule demands

title: Not going to get scared and run away: Mohamed Riyas after ED searches in CMRL pay-off case
summary: Claiming that he had not done anything wrong, the CPI(M) leader said that the details about his wife’s business venture had been mentioned in the affidavit submitted along with the nomination papers for the Keralam Assembly elections

title: Savarkar defamation case: Plea in High Court accuses Special Court of trying to determine if Savarkar was ‘brave or coward’
summary: The petitioner, claiming to possess expert knowledge of Savarkar’s life, contended that the subject before the Special Court is limited. He argues the court should only determine whether Savarkar wrote about beating up a Muslim in his books, and not go beyond this aspect.

title: Mumbai Cybercrime police arrest two from Bihar, Jharkhand in ₹48.60 lakh Boss scam
summary: It was also found that the accused were allegedly linked to almost seven similar cases across India.

title: FDA suspends license of Mumbai's Otters Club over analogue paneer; Crackdown on several other establishments across Maharashtra
summary: Other establishments across Maharashtra also had their licences suspended after inspections found alleged hygiene, storage, pest-control and food-safety violations during the ongoing statewide enforcement drive between July 14, 2026, and August 17, 2026
